## Modules

- [PhoenixKit](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.md): PhoenixKit

- [PhoenixKit.AWS.CredentialsVerifier](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.AWS.CredentialsVerifier.md): AWS credentials verification module.
- [PhoenixKit.AWS.InfrastructureSetup](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.AWS.InfrastructureSetup.md): Automated AWS infrastructure setup for email event handling.
- [PhoenixKit.AWS.SESv2](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.AWS.SESv2.md): AWS SES v2 API client for operations not supported by ExAws.
- [PhoenixKit.Activity](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Activity.md): Activity feed for tracking business-level actions across the platform.
- [PhoenixKit.Activity.Entry](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Activity.Entry.md): Schema for activity feed entries.
- [PhoenixKit.Activity.PruneWorker](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Activity.PruneWorker.md): Oban worker that prunes old activity entries based on the configured retention period.
- [PhoenixKit.Admin.Events](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Admin.Events.md): PubSub event broadcasting for PhoenixKit admin panels.
- [PhoenixKit.Admin.Presence](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Admin.Presence.md): Phoenix.Presence implementation for tracking anonymous and authenticated sessions.
- [PhoenixKit.Admin.SimplePresence](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Admin.SimplePresence.md): Simple presence tracking system for PhoenixKit admin interface.
- [PhoenixKit.Annotations](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Annotations.md): Context for `phoenix_kit_annotations` — drawn-on-image shapes created
via the Etcher overlay layer in the MediaBrowser modal.
- [PhoenixKit.Annotations.Annotation](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Annotations.Annotation.md): Ecto schema for `phoenix_kit_annotations`.
- [PhoenixKit.Application](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Application.md): OTP Application module for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.AuditLog](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.AuditLog.md): Context for managing audit logs in PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.AuditLog.Entry](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.AuditLog.Entry.md): Schema for audit log entries.
- [PhoenixKit.Cache](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Cache.md): Generic caching system for PhoenixKit with ETS-backed storage.
- [PhoenixKit.Cache.Registry](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Cache.Registry.md): Lightweight Registry wrapper for PhoenixKit.Cache instances.
- [PhoenixKit.Config](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.md): Configuration management system for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Config.AWS](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.AWS.md): AWS configuration management for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Config.AdminDashboardCategories](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.AdminDashboardCategories.md): Admin dashboard categories configuration and validation for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Config.EndpointUrlSync](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.EndpointUrlSync.md): Syncs the `site_url` from PhoenixKit settings to the parent Phoenix Endpoint's
`:url` configuration.
- [PhoenixKit.Config.UeberAuth](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.UeberAuth.md): Ueberauth configuration management for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Config.UserDashboardCategories](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Config.UserDashboardCategories.md): User dashboard categories configuration and validation for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.md): User Dashboard Tab Management System.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.AdminTabs](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.AdminTabs.md): Default admin navigation tabs for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Badge](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Badge.md): Defines badge types for dashboard tab indicators.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.ContextSelector](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.ContextSelector.md): Configuration and helpers for the dashboard context selector.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Group](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Group.md): Struct representing a dashboard tab group.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Presence](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Presence.md): Presence tracking for dashboard tabs.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Registry](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Registry.md): Registry for managing dashboard tabs across the application.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Tab](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.Tab.md): Defines the Tab struct and related types for the user dashboard navigation system.
- [PhoenixKit.Dashboard.TabHelpers](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Dashboard.TabHelpers.md): Shared helper functions for dashboard sidebar navigation.
- [PhoenixKit.Email.DefaultProvider](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Email.DefaultProvider.md): No-op email provider. Used when phoenix_kit_emails package is not installed.
- [PhoenixKit.Email.Provider](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Email.Provider.md): Unified email provider behaviour.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.ApplicationSupervisor](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.ApplicationSupervisor.md): Installation helper for adding PhoenixKit supervisor to parent application.
Used by `mix phoenix_kit.install` task.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.AssetRebuild](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.AssetRebuild.md): Handles asset rebuilding for PhoenixKit installations and updates.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.BasicConfiguration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.BasicConfiguration.md): Installation helper for adding PhoenixKit supervisor to parent application.
Used by `mix phoenix_kit.install` task.

- [PhoenixKit.Install.BootHook](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.BootHook.md): Wires `PhoenixKit.boot/1` into the parent app's `Application.start/2`.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.BrowserPipelineIntegration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.BrowserPipelineIntegration.md): Handles automatic integration of PhoenixKit plugs into the browser pipeline.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.Common](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.Common.md): Common utilities shared between PhoenixKit installation and update tasks.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.CssIntegration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.CssIntegration.md): Handles automatic Tailwind CSS + DaisyUI integration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.DbConnectionCheck](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.DbConnectionCheck.md): Simple database connection check for PhoenixKit installation.

- [PhoenixKit.Install.DemoFiles](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.DemoFiles.md): Handles copying demo test files for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.EndpointIntegration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.EndpointIntegration.md): Endpoint integration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.FinchSetup](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.FinchSetup.md): Handles automatic Finch and HTTP client setup for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.IgniterConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.IgniterConfig.md): Helper functions for working with Igniter to read and modify parent project configuration.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.IgniterHelpers](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.IgniterHelpers.md): Helper functions for working with Igniter to detect parent application information.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.JsIntegration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.JsIntegration.md): Handles automatic JavaScript hooks integration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.LayoutConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.LayoutConfig.md): Handles layout integration configuration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.MailerConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.MailerConfig.md): Handles mailer configuration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.MigrationStrategy](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.MigrationStrategy.md): Handles migration strategy determination and execution for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.OAuthConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.OAuthConfig.md): Handles OAuth configuration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.ObanConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.ObanConfig.md): Handles Oban configuration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.RateLimiterConfig](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.RateLimiterConfig.md): Handles Hammer rate limiter configuration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.RepoDetection](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.RepoDetection.md): Handles repository detection and validation for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.RouterIntegration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.RouterIntegration.md): Handles router integration for PhoenixKit installation.
- [PhoenixKit.Install.RuntimeDetector](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Install.RuntimeDetector.md): Detects Phoenix runtime configuration patterns and determines appropriate config strategy.
- [PhoenixKit.Integrations](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Integrations.md): Centralized management of external service integrations.
- [PhoenixKit.Integrations.Encryption](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Integrations.Encryption.md): AES-256-GCM encryption for sensitive integration credentials.
- [PhoenixKit.Integrations.Events](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Integrations.Events.md): PubSub helpers for broadcasting integration changes in real-time.
- [PhoenixKit.Integrations.OAuth](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Integrations.OAuth.md): Generic OAuth 2.0 flow for service integrations.
- [PhoenixKit.Integrations.Providers](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Integrations.Providers.md): Registry of known integration providers.
- [PhoenixKit.Jobs](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.Jobs.md): Jobs module for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKit.KnownPackages](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKit.KnownPackages.md): Live catalog of known external PhoenixKit packages fetched from Hex.pm.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix compile.phoenix_kit_css_sources](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Compile.PhoenixKitCssSources.md): Mix compiler that auto-generates CSS @source directives for PhoenixKit modules.
- [mix compile.phoenix_kit_js_sources](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Compile.PhoenixKitJsSources.md): Mix compiler that bundles external-module JavaScript hooks for the host app.
- [mix phoenix_kit.assets.rebuild](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Assets.Rebuild.md): Rebuilds assets for PhoenixKit using standard Phoenix asset pipeline.
- [mix phoenix_kit.cleanup_orphaned_files](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.CleanupOrphanedFiles.md): Finds and optionally deletes orphaned media files in PhoenixKit Storage.
- [mix phoenix_kit.doctor](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Doctor.md): Diagnoses PhoenixKit installation, migration, and runtime issues.
- [mix phoenix_kit.gen.admin.page](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Gen.Admin.Page.md): Igniter task that generates admin page with automatic route registration.
- [mix phoenix_kit.gen.migration](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Gen.Migration.md): Generate a PhoenixKit versioned migration for the parent application.
- [mix phoenix_kit.gen.user.dashboard](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Gen.User.Dashboard.md): Igniter task that generates a user dashboard page with tab configuration.
- [mix phoenix_kit.install](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Install.md): Igniter installer for PhoenixKit.
- [mix phoenix_kit.modernize_layouts](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.ModernizeLayouts.md): Modernizes PhoenixKit layout integration for Phoenix v1.8+ compatibility.
- [mix phoenix_kit.release_check](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.ReleaseCheck.md): Asserts release-metadata consistency before publishing to Hex.
- [mix phoenix_kit.status](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Status.md): Shows comprehensive status of PhoenixKit installation.
- [mix phoenix_kit.update](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKit.Update.md): Igniter-based updater for PhoenixKit.
- [mix phoenix_kit_templates](https://phoenix-kit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixKitTemplates.md): Template definitions for PhoenixKit demo pages.
